svg.title: Here ak is field scaling, L1 the constant coefficient, F the stencil footprint and Ck,L the scaled nonconstant candidate polynomial. All other regular activity terms of the primary lens are zero in this specialization. On the healthy compact chart the candidate is bounded by Ak,L uniformly in finer terminal cutoffand period; outside it the product is zero. The lens bound is |akL1|+Ak,L. Its read set lies in the coarse window of stencil radius plus four, since every inspected edge is within four sites of a stencil point.
